display_long_description:
Chess Star is a virtual reality chess game designed to deliver a focused, immersive, and distraction-free chess experience in VR.

Step into a realistic virtual environment where every move matters. Chess Star brings the classic game of chess into VR with intuitive controls, smooth interactions, and comfortable gameplay designed for long sessions.

Whether you are a beginner learning the fundamentals or an experienced player refining your strategy, Chess Star provides a calm and engaging atmosphere to enjoy chess like never before.

The game runs entirely offline and does not collect, store, or share any personal user data. All gameplay is processed locally on the device, ensuring privacy and security.

Key Features:
• Immersive VR chess environment  
• Classic chess rules and gameplay  
• Smooth and comfortable VR controls  
• Designed for focus and strategic thinking  
• No data collection or online requirements  

Chess Star is built for players who love chess and want a pure, immersive VR experience.
